newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says clears TRW buy of Germany's Magna.
newsitem.headline: EU says clears TRW buy of Germany's Magna.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it had cleared the acquisition of Germany's Magna Automotive Holding GmbH by TRW Inc, a U.S.-based firm which makes components and systens for the car and the space industries.
It said in a statement the deal would not affect fair trade in the markets concerned since TRW would still face competition from other important companies.
The Commission singled out Autoliv, Petri, Morton and Allied Signal as being able to rival TRW in the European market for airbag modules, which TRW will control to the extent of 35 percent.

The statement also noted that TRW will increase its share of the market for inflators for airbags to levels similar to Autoliv, the previous leader. But both will face the presence of Morton and other suppliers, it said.

Magna Automotive was previously owned by Magna Group Inc, which is also a major supplier of car components. The German company holds 80 percent of the shares in MST Automotive GmbH and in Temic Bayern - Chemie Airbag GmbH. -- Amelia Torres 322 2876841
